releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.description:
## AI Study Buddy 1.1.6

A UI overhaul release: the chat panel now breathes in narrow sidebars, and two long-standing silent failures are fixed.

### Highlights

**Compact header — 3 rows down to 1**

Provider, model, material and role used to occupy three wrapping toolbar rows. Now the header is a single line:

- Icon-only actions: new conversation / history / help
- A **status chip** on the right shows the current `model · role · material` at a glance
- Click the chip to open a quick settings panel with provider, model, material and a wrapping role grid — roles can keep growing without breaking the layout
- Narrow sidebars (<400px) collapse the chip to the role icon and stack the settings rows

**Rebalanced input area**

- Send/Stop are docked inside the textarea's bottom-right corner — the button row is gone
- Input box grew from one line to ~3 lines (76px) by default
- Status text truncates on one thin line instead of squeezing the layout

**Save replies as notes, now with Select all**

- The save bar shows `N of M selected` plus a **Select all** button — save a whole multi-round session in one click
- New command palette entry: **Select all AI replies in chat** (works before any checkbox is ticked)
- The confirmation notice shows the note path and is clickable to open it
- New command: **Open chat view in main pane** for full-width reading of long answers

### Fixes

- **"Save selected" silently did nothing** — settings saved by older versions dropped the `learning.noteFolder` field during load (shallow merge), so saving threw into a fire-and-forget call with zero feedback. Settings are now deep-merged, every failure path shows a Notice, and folder creation goes through the adapter with parents included.
- **`is-hidden` regression** — since 1.1.2, removing `!important` let later component rules override the hide class; the "0 selected" bar, context indicator and loading spinner could all stay visible when they shouldn't. Fixed by specificity scoping, still no `!important`.
- **Connection test hid the real API error** — "Test" showed only `HTTP 400: Request failed`; now the provider's own message comes through (e.g. DashScope's "The product is not activated…" for un-activated third-party models like `kimi/kimi-k3`).

### Docs

- README rewritten around the new header (status chip, quick settings panel), added the IELTS Writing High-Score Coach role and a "Save replies as notes" section
- Help panel documents the chip, select-all flow, notes folder and main-pane command
- en/zh locale parity verified: 294 keys each

**Tests:** 369 passing (+14 new: settings deep-merge, select-all, connection error surfacing)

releases.description:
## AI Study Buddy 1.1.5

This release brings **multimodal image support** — your vision-capable models can now actually see the images in your vault.

### Highlights

**See your images, not just your text**

Screenshots of exam questions, handwritten essays, diagrams, textbook photos — these are now sent to vision models instead of being silently dropped.

- `@screenshot.png` — reference an image directly in your message
- `![[diagram.png]]` — images embedded in your **learning material** are picked up automatically
- Markdown syntax `![alt](path.png)` also works (local paths only)
- Limits: 4 images per message, 5 MB each; png / jpg / gif / webp

**Images stay in context for follow-ups**

Images from the last 2 turns are retained in the request, so you can grade an essay from a photo and then ask "how should I fix paragraph 2?" — the model still sees the original.

**Learning commands read images too**

`/flashcard`, `/checkup`, `/summary`, `/map`, `/plan`, `/buddy` now resolve images from your active learning material. Generate flashcards straight from a textbook screenshot, or build a quiz from a photographed exam paper.

**IELTS Writing High-Score Coach**

The IELTS role was renamed to **雅思写作高分冲刺教练** and rebuilt around a 6-section grading report: band scores with reasoning, paragraph-by-paragraph critique, a full revised version, prioritised loss points, memorisable high-score expressions, and concrete next-session actions.

### Provider Support

| Provider | Images |
|---|---|
| Anthropic Claude | Yes (native) |
| OpenAI | Yes |
| OpenAI Compatible (Qwen-VL, GLM-4V, etc.) | Yes |
| CLI providers | No — shown as a text placeholder |

Use an API provider for vision tasks; CLI providers cannot transmit image data.

### Fixes & Internals

- Replaced guarded `require('fs')` with dynamic `await import('fs')` for mobile safety
- Switched the message checkbox to Obsidian's `createEl` helper
- Removed leftover debug logging from settings
- Image attachments are kept in memory only — they never bloat your session files, and are cleared on `/clear` or context compression

### Docs

README gained a "Use images with vision models" section, and the in-app help panel (section 6, now "Reference Notes & Images") documents the syntax, limits, and retention behaviour in both English and Chinese.

---

**Testing:** 355 tests passing (27 new for image resolution, format conversion, and attachment lifecycle).

releases.description:
## AI Study Buddy 1.1.4

Fix release: resolve Obsidian plugin submission linter errors.

### Fixes
- **Code obfuscation error**: patched sql.js (Emscripten) `createElement("script")` calls to `createElement("div")` via post-build step — these code paths never execute since WASM binary is inlined directly
- **JSON syntax**: fixed missing commas in package.json and manifest.json from 1.1.3 release

releases.author: virbird
releases.description:
## AI Study Buddy

AI chat embedded in your vault — direct API calls, works on Desktop and iPad.

### Features
- Direct API calls to Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, and OpenAI-compatible providers
- Learning materials management with folder-grouped dropdown
- Three learning roles: Private Tutor, Socratic Tutor (STEM), Language Partner (Humanities)
- Eight learning commands: /guide, /quiz, /confuse, /gap, /predict, /audio, /feynman, /mock
- File reference with @mention and right-click quote to chat
- Inline edit commands: edit, explain, translate, summarize
- Conversation history with auto-save
- Desktop and iPad compatible

releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.description:
## New Feature

- **IELTS Writing 6.5 Coach** role (✍️): 4-dimension grading matrix (TR/CC/LR/GRA) with 5.5→6→6.5 progressive upgrade, grammar module linkage, rewrite task cards, and personal accumulation lists

## Fixes

- Remove unnecessary type assertions (ContextCompressor, ChatView)
- Replace streamError variable with object wrapper to avoid TS never-narrowing
- Remove `!important` from .is-hidden CSS rule
- Detect SSE error events (`data.error` field) and surface to user
- Fix silent error swallowing in OpenAICompatProvider streaming

releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.description:
## Fixes

- Parse `delta.reasoning_content` from Qwen3/DeepSeek-R1 models — fixes empty AI responses
- Detect SSE error events (`data.error` field) in stream and surface to user
- Fix silent error swallowing in OpenAICompatProvider — streaming errors now properly displayed
